claim_boundary: descriptive horizon scope of fixed-centroid local-linear geometry; reused cases, not independent replication; no evidence-code, memory-use, causal-channel, AFP or chaos claim
source: reuse exact captured A states, training32 history indices, evaluation axes and rank8 basis from the hash-verified source artifact; centroid remains the training A mean
G_h: h identical blank-input injections and recurrent steps from runtime index38, reset inside every evaluation; identical seed weights; no relinearization at evaluation or target states
targets: float32 nonlinear continuations are measured targets; h2 must exactly match existing independently collected B checkpoints; float64 discrepancy reported
denominator: fixed evaluation A-cloud RMS for all horizons; no target-time normalization
coverage: report both cloud-centered variance excluded from rank8 and train-reference-centered evaluation-direction/centroid displacement excluded from rank8; do not conflate them
metrics: full/centered/centroid and in/out subspace residuals; displacement fraction explained; every seed-axis-horizon cell retained
descriptive_threshold: relative full residual <=0.1 at every seed and both axes at a horizon; first sampled failure reported descriptively only
falsifier: large heldout residual bounds the horizon where the fixed local-linear description is useful; no selected-horizon hypothesis inference
independent_unit: existing four parameter seeds; horizons and histories are dependent extensions of the same cases
